item.title: How Was Kailasa Temple Carved From Top to Bottom? The Impossible Monolith of Ellora Cave 16
item.description: Over 200,000 tonnes of basalt rock scooped out with precision chisels from top to bottom. Modern civil engineers admit this monolithic marvel cannot be replicated today even with laser-guided excavators.

item.title: The Mystery of Brihadeeswarar Temple: 80-Tonne Single-Stone Cap & The Zero Noon Shadow Legend
item.description: Built by Rajaraja Chola I in 1010 CE entirely out of granite in a region with no granite quarries for 60 miles. How did ancient builders haul an 80-tonne granite dome atop a 216-foot tower without mortar?

item.title: 8 Unexplained Phenomena of Puri Jagannath Temple That Defy Modern Physics
item.description: The sacred flag that flies against the wind direction, zero bird flight path above the Neela Chakra, and ocean waves that silence instantly when stepping through the Singhadwara.

item.title: The Hanging Pillar of Lepakshi: Vijayanagara's Anti-Gravity Architectural Miracle
item.description: Among the 70 massive stone pillars of Veerabhadra temple, one granite pillar does not touch the ground at all. Devotees pass cloths completely beneath it without friction.

item.title: The Sealed Vault B of Padmanabhaswamy Temple: The Unopened Snake Door & Trillion-Dollar Treasure
item.description: While Vaults A, C, D, E, and F yielded over $22 Billion in pure gold idols and diamonds, Vault B remains sealed behind a steel door engraved with two gigantic cobras without a single lock, bolt, or keyhole.

item.title: Konark Sun Temple: The Lost Magnetic Chariot & The Sundials That Measure Time to the Second
item.description: Ancient legends record that a massive lodestone at the pinnacle of Konark temple held the sun deity idol levitating in mid-air through electromagnetic equilibrium, until Portuguese ships dismantled it.

item.title: The Baan Stambha of Somnath: How Ancient Rishis Knew There Was No Land Between Gujarat & Antarctica
item.description: Inscribed in 6th century Sanskrit: 'From this point to the South Pole, there is not a single piece of land obstacle.' How did ancient Indian astronomers map the Indian Ocean to Antarctica without satellites?

item.title: The 56 Musical Pillars of Hampi: Resonating Sa-Re-Ga-Ma Through Solid Granite
item.description: British colonizers cut open two pillars in Vittala Temple to find the hidden bells inside, only to discover completely solid granite blocks engineered to vibrate at musical octaves.

item.title: Acoustic Secrets of the Hall of 1000 Pillars: Madurai Meenakshi Temple's Sonic Engineering
item.description: Stand at any pillar in the 985-pillar hall and your voice will echo at a harmonic frequency that cancels out crowd noise while amplifying Vedic chanting.

item.title: How Kedarnath Temple Survived Buried Under Ice for 400 Years: Geological Wonder of Garhwal
item.description: Geological research by the Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology confirms Kedarnath was completely submerged under a glacial ice sheet for four centuries (1300–1700 CE) without structural damage.

item.title: Did Surya Siddhanta Calculate the Speed of Light and Earth's Orbit 1,500 Years Before Newton?
item.description: 14th-century scholar Sayana commentary on Rigveda 1.50.4 calculates light traveling 2,202 Yojanas in half a Nimesha — translating to 186,413 miles per second, within 0.04% of modern physics.

item.title: The Rustless Iron Pillar of Delhi: 1,600 Years in Rain and Sun Without a Speck of Corrosion
item.description: Erected during the Gupta Empire around 400 CE, this 6-tonne wrought iron pillar possesses high phosphorus and low sulfur content, forming a catalytic protective layer called Misawite.

item.title: Sushruta: The Ancient Indian Father of Plastic Surgery, Cataract Extraction & 125 Surgical Tools
item.description: 600 BCE pioneer Sushruta documented forensic dissection, rhinoplasty (forehead flap reconstruction used today), cesarean sections, bone grafting, and 125 distinct precision surgical instruments.

item.title: Vimana Shastra & Ancient Aviation: Deconstructing the Mercury Vortex Engine & Shakuna Vimana
item.description: Ancient Sanskrit texts like Samarangana Sutradhara describe heavier-than-air flying craft powered by heated mercury vapor turbines capable of vertical takeoff and directional maneuvering.

item.title: The Baudhayana Theorem: How Ancient Indian Altars Proved Pythagoras 300 Years Earlier
item.description: Baudhayana Sulba Sutra (800 BCE) states: 'The diagonal of a rectangle produces by itself both the areas which the length and breadth produce separately.' Includes the value of √2 to 5 decimal places.

item.title: Rishi Kanada & Vaisheshika: The 6th Century BCE Atomic Theory of Paramanu
item.description: Long before John Dalton, Rishi Kanada established that all matter is composed of indestructible, indivisible spherical particles called 'Paramanu' that combine in pairs (Dwinuka) to form molecules.

item.title: The Submerged City of Dwarka: Marine Archaeological Proof of Krishna's Golden Metropolis
item.description: Dr. S.R. Rao's marine excavations off Gujarat coast revealed fortified sea-walls, triangular stone anchors, seal impressions, and pottery dating back to 1500–7500 BCE, matching the epic description of Dwarka sinking beneath the Arabian Sea.

item.description: Space Applications Centre (ISRO) satellite sensors mapped subterranean palaeochannels beneath the Thar Desert, proving a mighty 8-km wide perennial river flowed from the Himalayas to Gujarat between 6000 and 1900 BCE.

item.title: Ram Setu (Adam's Bridge): Carbon Dating, Pumice Floating Stones & The 7,000-Year-Old Causeway
item.description: Geological analysis by scientists and NASA satellite surveys reveal that the stone boulders of Ram Setu are 7,000 years old while the sand beneath them is only 4,000 years old — confirming boulders were brought from elsewhere and placed atop the sandbar.

item.title: 136.1 Hz: The Science of OM Frequency and How It Synchronizes Human Brainwaves with the Earth's Year
item.description: Hans Cousto's 'Cosmic Octave' calculated the frequency of the Earth orbiting the Sun as an astronomical tone: when transposed 32 octaves higher into human hearing range, it vibrates at exactly 136.10 Hz (C# in 432 Hz tuning), identical to traditional Vedic OM.
